uutiset.t: Durham appoint Gibson as head coach
uutiset.s: Durham appoint Ottis Gibson as their new head coach on a three-year deal.

uutiset.t: Southampton give head coach Eckert new deal
uutiset.s: Southampton head coach Tonda Eckert signs a new contract at the club through until 2029.

uutiset.t: ATP increases player compensation to $350m & delays doubles cuts decision
uutiset.s: The men's ATP Tour promises players rewards of at least $350m in 2028 - but delays a decision on hotly-disputed changes to doubles until next month.

uutiset.t: McDowall goes from farm hand to Scotland captain as Darge injured
uutiset.s: Stafford McDowall was working on his dad's farm when he got the call to play for Scotland against Australia on Sunday - and six days later will be captain against Japan after Rory Darge suffered a late injury blow.

uutiset.t: GB's Davis Cup-winning captain ends 17-year stint
uutiset.s: Leon Smith says helping Britain end a 79-year wait to win the Davis Cup is "one of the proudest moments" of his career.

uutiset.t: Wales face Slovenia in Nations League play-off
uutiset.s: Wales will face Slovenia in a two-leg play-off next March to maintain their top-flight status in the Nations League.

uutiset.t: Stoke and Birmingham proving you shouldn't judge a book by its cover
uutiset.s: Stoke host Birmingham in a Championship game of two teams both bang in form going into the latest international break. How will they re-emerge?

uutiset.t: CJ Stroud leads Texans to comfortable win over Colts
uutiset.s: Quarterback CJ Stroud leads the Houston Texans to a comfortable 26-3 win over AFC South rivals Indianapolis Colts.

uutiset.t: UFC title contender Fiorot banned for three months
uutiset.s: Highly ranked UFC flyweight Manon Fiorot is banned for three months for violating the promotion's anti-doping policy.

uutiset.t: Cummins retains Cricket Australia support as captain
uutiset.s: Pat Cummins will retain backing from Cricket Australia to remain as Test captain despite ongoing and explosive allegations about the sandpaper controversy.

uutiset.t: Rams star Nacua suspended after assault lawsuit
uutiset.s: Puka Nacua is given a three-game suspension for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy, although the Los Angeles Rams wide receiver was already out injured.

uutiset.t: Scots lose Super Six opening thriller to Dutch
uutiset.s: Scotland fall to a final-over, seven-wicket defeat by the Netherlands in their opening match in the Super Six stage of the Women's Emerging Nations Trophy.

uutiset.t: PWR title, England recall, Lions tour - ambitious Atkin-Davies returns
uutiset.s: England and Bristol hooker Lark Atkin-Davies on her aims of winning a PWR title and making the Lions tour as she returns to the sport a new mum.

uutiset.t: EFL preview: Evans' gripes & unexpected departures
uutiset.s: BBC Sport explores five things to capture your attention this EFL weekend.

uutiset.t: Refereeing will never be perfect - Farrell
uutiset.s: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell says refereeing in rugby is "never going to be perfect" because it is such a complex sport.
